mapper.sql: id, user_id, problem_slug, outline_json, note_markdown, revision, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, problem_slug, outline_json, char_length(note_markdown) > 0 AS has_note_markdown, revision, created_at, updated_at FROM user_problem_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND problem_slug = #{problemSlug}

INSERT INTO user_problem_note ( user_id, problem_slug, outline_json, note_markdown, revision, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{problemSlug}, #{outlineJson, typeHandler=org.congcong.algomentor.agent.persistence.postgres.json.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{noteMarkdown}, 1, #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, problem_slug) DO NOTHING RETURNING
